name: Kkalpana Plastick Limited
about: Kkalpana Plastick Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company is involved in the business of polymer plastic compounds in India. The company was formerly known as Kalpena Plastiks Limited and changed its name to Kkalpana Plastick Limited in March 2015. The company Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Kolkata, India. Kkalpana Plastick Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bbigplas Poly Private Limited.
